todos.title: Create a Google Drive folder
todos.description: This would be shared with the SOC 2 auditors. Inside this main folder, later on, will be 58 folders (preferably name them 01 - 58) that will contain the evidence for each control.

todos.title: Provide screenshots of quarterly Board Meeting calendar invites + meeting minutes
todos.description: Quarterly board meetings are required for SOC 2 compliance. You need calendar invites and meeting minutes as evidence.

actions.label: Generate a quarterly Board Meeting invite

todos.title: Provide screenshots of quarterly Management Meeting calendar invites + meeting minutes
todos.description: Quarterly management meetings are required for SOC 2 compliance. You need calendar invites and meeting minutes as evidence.

actions.label: Generate a quarterly Management Meeting invite

todos.title: Provide Organizational Chart
todos.description: An organizational chart showing the company hierarchy and reporting structure is required for SOC 2 compliance.

todos.title: Provide screenshot/s of product description
todos.description: This can be the company public website, public docs or anything else public. Screenshots should show what your product does and its key features.

todos.title: Provide all company policies + Management calendar invite for review + screenshot that all company have access
todos.description: You can generate policies one by one under 'Actions/Generate Policies'. Make sure to also provide evidence of a management review meeting and that all employees have access to these policies.

todos.title: Provide a doc explaining where are you posting job descriptions + example of one job description
todos.description: Document where job postings are published (LinkedIn, company website, job boards, etc.) and include an example of a job description used for hiring.

todos.title: Provide Background Checks Process
todos.description: Document your background checks process for new hires. Different countries have different legal requirements.

todos.title: Provide Employee Onboarding process + screenshots of signatures
todos.description: Provide a doc that shows the process of how new employees get access to applications. The screenshots show that they actually completed the process.

actions.label: Generate 'Access to new apps process' doc

todos.title: Provide an NDA template
todos.description: Provide your company's Non-Disclosure Agreement template that is signed by employees and contractors.

todos.title: Provide Security Awareness Training materials + screenshots of signatures saying they read it
todos.description: Provide security awareness training materials and evidence that employees have completed the training.

todos.title: Provide Technical Training Resources + screenshots of signatures saying they read it
todos.description: These resources are for your employees. Provide technical training materials relevant to your stack and evidence of completion.

todos.title: Provide a screenshot of how you communicate new features to customers
todos.description: This can be your public docs, a Slack channel, email newsletter, changelog page, or anything else you use to communicate product updates to customers.

todos.title: Provide a screenshot of how you communicate new features to employees
todos.description: This can be your internal docs, a Slack channel, team meetings, or anything else you use to communicate product updates to employees.

todos.title: Provide Risk Registry + screenshot of calendar invite + meeting minutes
todos.description: A risk registry documents identified risks, their likelihood, impact, and mitigation strategies. Include evidence of regular risk review meetings.

todos.title: Provide Section 3
todos.description: Section 3 contains detailed information about your company's control environment and security practices.
